Reproduction and publication notes

Publication checklist

  1. Download the pack and verify the input WASM checksum. Review the source and build notes.
  2. Use a funded Ootle mainnet wallet with a Publish Template/upload form. Sapient’s checked dApp connector does not expose binary blobs for publication.
  3. Upload the WASM, select your fee account and run Estimate Fee. Review the actual estimate and choose your own spending limit. The latest wallet dry run estimated 0.786209 TARI; re-estimate for your account before publishing.
  4. Review and publish once. If the result is uncertain, recover its transaction status before retrying. An AcceptFeeRejectRest outcome does not publish the template.
  5. Return the mainnet publication transaction ID, template address, timestamp, execution result and actual fee. If wallet optimization changes the binary, also return the optimized artifact and its checksum.

Publication records your publisher identity publicly. We will disclose external publication help in the entry; contest eligibility and ranking belong to the organizers. No recovery words or private keys are needed.

What happens next

Specter pins the verified mainnet deployment and can request commit calls through Sapient. Export your report, review the public-link disclosure and 0.1 TARI fee cap, then request approval. Submission remains a separate user action. A live receipt transaction committed through the developer-wallet manifest flow. Stored fields match the exported evidence, and all getter calls committed. Review the live receipt evidence ↗. Sapient-specific live execution is now verified. Review Sapient evidence ↗.

Contract: SpecterReportReceipt
Function: commit(report_sha256: String, transaction_id: String)
Both arguments: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

The receipt stores the digest, inspected transaction ID, signer key and consensus epoch. It does not prove report accuracy, transaction existence or anonymity. Signer identity and links are public; duplicate commitments are allowed.
